title: Is there Gaelic on you?
html_source: According to Gifford, “a west-of-Ireland, peasant colloquialism” for “do you speak Irish”?

anchor.prefix:
Stephen asked her. 

 — Is it French you are talking, sir? the old woman said to Haines. 

 Haines spoke to her again a longer speech, confidently. 

 — Irish, Buck Mulligan said.
anchor.suffix:
